summary: Iteration 56 - POS Advanced Features (QR Ordering, Receipts, Happy Hour, Guest Preferences, Loyalty). Backend: 23/23 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 7 POS tabs working, QR public ordering page functional.
critical_code_review_comments: PUBLIC endpoints (GET/POST /api/pos/public/*) correctly require NO authentication for QR ordering
Happy Hour auto-seeds 2 default promotions on first access (Happy Hour 16:00-19:00 25% off, Early Bird Breakfast 6:00-8:00 15% off)
Happy Hour pricing correctly applied to public menu when active
Loyalty points system: 1 point per £1 for standard, 1.5x silver, 2x gold, 3x platinum
Loyalty tier auto-upgrade: standard < 500 < silver < 2000 < gold < 5000 < platinum
Guest preferences track dietary restrictions, allergens, favorites, dislikes
Guest order history calculates top items and total spent
Digital receipts sent via Resend (sandbox sender: onboarding@resend.dev)
QR orders create order_type='qr_order' with order_number prefix 'QR-'
Frontend POS panel has 7 tabs: POS Terminal, Tables, Kitchen, Orders, Reports, Happy Hour, QR Order
QR Order tab shows all 6 outlets with copy link buttons
Orders tab shows Receipt button for paid orders
Public QR ordering page mobile-optimized at /qr-order/{property_id}/{outlet_id}
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All 7 tabs and QR ordering page working)

seed_data_creation: Test orders created with TEST_ prefix for QR ordering, loyalty points, and guest preferences
